soal.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan Net Pay dalam evaluasi petrofisika?

Bagian batuan yang memiliki porositas di atas cutoff
correct_option: Bagian reservoir yang mengandung hidrokarbon ekonomis
Bagian batuan yang memiliki porositas di atas cutoff
soal.question_en: What is meant by Net Pay in petrophysical evaluation?
options_en: The part of the reservoir containing economic hydrocarbons
The rock section with porosity above cutoff
The part of the reservoir with zero permeability
The part of the reservoir 100% water saturated
correct_option_en: The part of the reservoir containing economic hydrocarbons
The rock section with porosity above cutoff

soal.question: Apa kelemahan utama penggunaan HPAM (Hydrolyzed Polyacrylamide) pada kondisi reservoir dengan salinitas tinggi?
options: Sensitif terhadap salinitas tinggi yang menyebabkan penurunan viskositas
soal.correct_option: Sensitif terhadap salinitas tinggi yang menyebabkan penurunan viskositas
soal.question_en: What is the main disadvantage of using HPAM (Hydrolyzed Polyacrylamide) in high salinity reservoir conditions?
options_en: Sensitive to high salinity causing viscosity loss
Very expensive compared to other polymers
soal.correct_option_en: Sensitive to high salinity causing viscosity loss

Reservoir dengan saturasi minyak sisa sangat rendah

options_en: Reservoirs with very low residual oil saturation

soal.question: Apa dampak negatif dari degradasi mekanis (shear degradation) pada polimer HPAM?
options: Penurunan berat molekul dan kehilangan viskositas
soal.correct_option: Penurunan berat molekul dan kehilangan viskositas
soal.question_en: What is the negative impact of shear degradation on HPAM polymer?
options_en: Reduction in molecular weight and loss of viscosity
soal.correct_option_en: Reduction in molecular weight and loss of viscosity

soal.question: Mengapa injeksi polimer lebih unggul daripada waterflooding konvensional dalam hal perolehan minyak?
options: Memperbaiki vertical dan areal sweep efficiency
Menghilangkan kebutuhan akan fasilitas pengolahan air
soal.correct_option: Memperbaiki vertical dan areal sweep efficiency
soal.question_en: Why is polymer injection superior to conventional waterflooding in terms of oil recovery?
options_en: Improves vertical and areal sweep efficiency
Eliminates the need for water treatment facilities
soal.correct_option_en: Improves vertical and areal sweep efficiency

soal.question: Apa tujuan utama dari proses pre-flush dalam desain Chemical EOR?
options: Menyesuaikan salinitas dan pH lingkungan reservoir
Membersihkan sisa bor di dekat lubang sumur
soal.correct_option: Menyesuaikan salinitas dan pH lingkungan reservoir
soal.question_en: What is the main purpose of pre-flush in Chemical EOR design?
options_en: Adjusting salinity and pH of the reservoir environment
Cleaning drilling residue near the wellbore
soal.correct_option_en: Adjusting salinity and pH of the reservoir environment

soal.question: Bagaimana pengaruh suhu reservoir yang sangat tinggi terhadap stabilitas kimiawi HPAM?
soal.question_en: How does very high reservoir temperature affect the chemical stability of HPAM?

soal.question: Dalam konteks polimer flooding, apa yang dimaksud dengan 'resistance factor'?
options: Rasio mobilitas air terhadap mobilitas larutan polimer
Rasio viskositas polimer terhadap viskositas air
Rasio permeabilitas batuan setelah dan sebelum injeksi
soal.correct_option: Rasio mobilitas air terhadap mobilitas larutan polimer
soal.question_en: In the context of polymer flooding, what is meant by 'resistance factor'?
options_en: Ratio of water mobility to polymer solution mobility
Ratio of polymer viscosity to water viscosity
Ratio of rock permeability after and before injection
soal.correct_option_en: Ratio of water mobility to polymer solution mobility

soal.question: Manakah yang benar tentang karakteristik Xanthan Gum?
soal.question_en: Which of the following are true about the characteristics of Xanthan Gum?

soal.question: Apa tantangan utama dalam implementasi lapangan injeksi polimer yang berkaitan dengan sumur injeksi?
soal.question_en: What is the main challenge in field implementation of polymer injection related to injection wells?
options_en: Formation plugging due to high viscosity
Injection pump damage due to corrosion
soal.correct_option_en: Formation plugging due to high viscosity

soal.question: Apa keuntungan menggunakan polimer dibandingkan dengan waterflooding saja pada reservoir heterogen?
options: Mengurangi aliran melalui zona dengan permeabilitas tinggi (thief zones)
Menggantikan seluruh volume minyak dalam reservoir
soal.correct_option: Mengurangi aliran melalui zona dengan permeabilitas tinggi (thief zones)
soal.question_en: What is the advantage of using polymer compared to waterflooding alone in heterogeneous reservoirs?
options_en: Reduces flow through high permeability zones (thief zones)
Replaces the entire oil volume in the reservoir
soal.correct_option_en: Reduces flow through high permeability zones (thief zones)

soal.question: Apa mekanisme utama injeksi uap untuk meningkatkan perolehan minyak pada reservoir minyak berat?
options: Penurunan viskositas minyak akibat kenaikan temperatur
Peningkatan saturasi air residual di dalam pori
Peningkatan tegangan antarmuka antara uap dan minyak
soal.correct_option: Penurunan viskositas minyak akibat kenaikan temperatur
soal.question_en: What is the primary recovery mechanism of steam injection in heavy oil reservoirs?
options_en: Reduction of oil viscosity due to temperature increase
Increase of residual water saturation in the pores
Change of rock wettability to oil-wet
Increase of interfacial tension between steam and oil
soal.correct_option_en: Reduction of oil viscosity due to temperature increase

soal.question: Manakah pernyataan yang benar mengenai metode Cyclic Steam Stimulation (CSS) atau huff and puff?
options: Melibatkan tiga tahap yaitu injeksi, perendaman (soak), dan produksi pada sumur yang sama
Dilakukan dengan injeksi uap secara kontinu melalui sumur injeksi yang berbeda dari sumur produksi
Metode ini sangat efektif untuk reservoir dengan permeabilitas yang sangat rendah
Meniadakan kebutuhan akan tekanan injeksi yang tinggi
soal.correct_option: Melibatkan tiga tahap yaitu injeksi, perendaman (soak), dan produksi pada sumur yang sama
soal.question_en: Which statement is correct regarding the Cyclic Steam Stimulation (CSS) or huff and puff method?
options_en: Involves three stages: injection, soak, and production in the same well
Conducted by continuous steam injection through an injector well different from the producer
This method is highly effective for reservoirs with very low permeability
Eliminates the need for high injection pressures
soal.correct_option_en: Involves three stages: injection, soak, and production in the same well

soal.question: Parameter apa saja yang digunakan untuk mengevaluasi efisiensi ekonomi dan teknis dari proyek injeksi uap?
soal.question_en: Which parameters are used to evaluate the economic and technical efficiency of steam injection projects?

soal.question: Apa perbedaan utama antara metode Steamflood dibandingkan dengan Cyclic Steam Stimulation?
options: Steamflood menggunakan pola sumur injeksi dan produksi yang terpisah secara kontinu
Steamflood tidak menyebabkan perubahan viskositas minyak
Cyclic Steam Stimulation memiliki efisiensi sapuan (sweep efficiency) yang lebih luas daripada Steamflood
Steamflood hanya bisa dilakukan pada reservoir dangkal dengan tekanan sangat rendah
soal.correct_option: Steamflood menggunakan pola sumur injeksi dan produksi yang terpisah secara kontinu
soal.question_en: What is the main difference between Steamflood and Cyclic Steam Stimulation?
options_en: Steamflood uses a separate injection and production well pattern continuously
Steamflood does not cause changes in oil viscosity
Cyclic Steam Stimulation has a wider sweep efficiency than Steamflood
Steamflood can only be performed in shallow reservoirs with very low pressure
soal.correct_option_en: Steamflood uses a separate injection and production well pattern continuously

soal.question: Bagaimana pengaruh kenaikan temperatur terhadap perolehan minyak pada proses thermal EOR?
options: Meningkatkan mobilitas minyak di dalam media berpori
Menurunkan mobilitas minyak karena ekspansi termal
Tidak memberikan pengaruh signifikan terhadap mobilitas fluida
Meningkatkan tegangan permukaan yang menghambat aliran
soal.correct_option: Meningkatkan mobilitas minyak di dalam media berpori
soal.question_en: How does an increase in temperature affect oil recovery in thermal EOR processes?
options_en: Increases oil mobility within the porous media
Decreases oil mobility due to thermal expansion
Does not significantly affect fluid mobility
Increases surface tension which inhibits flow
soal.correct_option_en: Increases oil mobility within the porous media
